name: Baby Rubber Plant
hook: Leaves dropping? Your peperomia is too wet.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: An east or south window is ideal. Direct sun scorches the leaves, but it copes with low light for months.

steps.title: Let the soil dry first
steps.tip: Water only once the soil has dried, then let it drain. Soggy soil causes leaf drop and root rot.

steps.title: Fast-draining mix
steps.tip: Use a fast-draining houseplant or cactus mix. It rarely needs repotting and can stay in one pot for years.

steps.title: Feed lightly in summer
steps.tip: Give a weak liquid fertilizer now and then in spring and summer, or one slow-release dose a year.

steps.title: Root cuttings in water
steps.tip: Cut a 10–15 cm stem just below a node (leaf joint) and stand it in water in bright, indirect light.

steps.title: Check for mealybugs
steps.tip: Look for mealybugs, spider mites and whiteflies, and keep leaves dry when watering to avoid leaf spots.

outro: Bright light and dry soil between drinks keep it plump for years.

sources.title: Clemson HGIC: Peperomia Indoor Plant Care and Growing Guide
